title: Normalize relative section continuity to coefficients over a common base
statement: For a cofiltered diagram D:I→Over(S) of qcqs schemes with affine transitions, a qcqs underlying limit cone c, Grothendieck abelian A, an A-valued étale sheaf F on S, and a stage i, there exist a presheaf-valued tail diagram P, object identifications with sections of F_j on the base change from D_i to D_j, and a cocone to the analogous limit presheaf. Its legs are the displayed canonical tailSectionMap and evaluation on every qcqs étale object of D_i is colimiting.

source.place: Detailed proof, paragraph 2: finite skeleton descent and finite-cochain section continuity; explicit categorical construction with Grothendieck coefficients.

external.place: Tag 09YQ, degree zero (abelian coefficients); arbitrary Grothendieck coefficients by the categorical finite-matching argument stated in the proof

proof.text: Use the explicit relative section diagram and cocone for the sheaf G=(D_i→S)*F. At every tail stage and at the limit, inverse-image composition identifies these objects with the stated common-base coefficient sheaves. Naturality of the unit, the inverse of inverse-image associativity, and naturality along the pullback-pasting map prove that the normalized cocone legs are exactly tailSectionMap. Evaluate the limit coefficient isomorphism and transport the degree-zero continuity colimit through this cocone isomorphism.

theorem exists_tail_section_colimit
    [IsCofiltered I] [∀ {i j} (g : i ⟶ j), IsAffineHom (D.map g).left]
    (F : Sheaf S.smallEtaleTopology A)
    (hc : IsLimit ((Over.forget S).mapCone c)) (i : I) :
    ∃ (P : (Over i)ᵒᵖ ⥤ ((D.obj i).left.Etaleᵒᵖ ⥤ A))
      (e : ∀ j, P.obj j ≅ tailSections A D F i j.unop)
      (ν : P ⟶ (Functor.const (Over i)ᵒᵖ).obj
        ((coneProjection D c i).Etale.op ⋙ ((Etale.upperStar A c.pt.hom).obj F).obj)),
      (∀ j, ν.app j = (e j).hom ≫ tailSectionMap A D c F i j.unop) ∧
        ∀ (U : (D.obj i).left.Etale), CompactSpace U.left → QuasiSeparatedSpace U.left →
          Nonempty (IsColimit (((evaluation _ A).obj (op U)).mapCocone
            (Cocone.mk _ ν)))
